title: tissa diandra subsp. bracteata
intro: Tissa diandra subsp. bracteata, commonly known as Wild Mahogany, is a plant species from the family Sapindaceae. It is a shrub native to Sri Lanka, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Tissa diandra subsp. bracteata, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
